plain.li: [moths] There must be a hundred moths on that lamp, I've never seen so many.
[moths] The moths all came to the light at once, and they won't leave it.
[moths] Look at the moths round the light, pale as the moon, every one of them.
[waterrisen] The water's come up in the night, and it never rained.
[waterrisen] It stands a hand higher than yesterday, with not a drop of rain.
[waterrisen] The ground's wet right up to here this morning, and the sky was clear all night.
[sunshaft] Look, the sun's come through on just that one spot.
[sunshaft] Everything's gray except there, where the light's coming down.
[sunshaft] One beam of sun through all that cloud, and it isn't moving.
